title: fix(lint): resolve the MCP door's file tools read_file and create_upload_link in ai-skill-tool-unresolved
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Closes #34948

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：技能（skill）绑定 `read_file` 或 `create_upload_link` 时，只要该技能会在 MCP 上提供（`mcpPrompt !== false`），`os lint --strict` 不再报 `ai-skill-tool-unresolved`。这两个文件工具由本仓的 MCP 入口提供，现在单独列在 spec 新常量 `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES` 里。声明 `mcpPrompt: false` 的技能只在产品内对话里运行，那里没有这两个工具，所以仍然照报。
- **为什么改**：hotcrm 的报销助手需要读票据、发上传链接，MCP 上这两个工具能用，但 lint 把它们当成不存在的工具，作者只好不绑定、把工具名写进说明文字里，技能的真实需求就没有声明出来。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只让一条提示级规则少报两个名字，不改任何 MCP 工具行为，也不改 `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`（MCP 桥接的工具注解读它，云端一致性测试也以它为准）。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`（新常量，以及它为什么不放进云端分组）；`packages/mcp/src/mcp-file-tools.test.ts`（把 MCP 实际注册的文件工具和这份清单钉死为相等）；`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`（工具全集多读一份）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts`，预期 26 个用例全绿：`resolves the MCP door's file tools` 通过、对照名 `upload_file` 仍被报；新对照 `still reports the MCP file tools on a skill kept out of MCP (mcpPrompt: false)` 确认 `mcpPrompt: false` 的技能绑定 `read_file` 仍报一条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `@objectstack/spec/system` gains `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES` (`create_upload_link`, `read_file`): exactly what `registerFileTools` in `@objectstack/mcp` registers on a bridge carrying every file member. It is a separate constant, not a group in `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE`, so the registry's maintenance statement stays true (each group is the exact set one cloud package registers, with conformance tests in the cloud repo). It is also kept out of `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`, which `mcp-server-runtime.ts` reads to assert `openWorldHint: false` on bridged cloud tools; adding the names there would change MCP tool annotations. The ui label-parity test reads `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` only, so no `chatbot.tool.NAME` labels are owed.
- `ai-skill-tool-unresolved` (`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`) resolves `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES` **per skill, only where `skill.mcpPrompt !== false`** (helper `offeredOverMcp`; seat ruling in contract review 6964565007, S1). A skill its owner keeps out of MCP runs only in-product, where the pair is not registered, so it still resolves against stack tools, `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES` and `action_*` only, and its near-miss suggestions come from that same set. `collectToolUniverse` no longer carries the pair. Nothing that resolved before is reported now.
- `os explain ai-skill-tool-unresolved` (`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`) names the new source and its limit: the pair resolves only for a skill offered over MCP, an in-product turn runs without it, and a `mcpPrompt: false` skill is still reported. The rule's test checks the explanation names every source and the limit.
- The three in-PR restatements of the resolution ladder now name the fourth source with its MCP condition (comment and jsdoc text only): `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts` (the `tools` jsdoc), `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`. `content/docs/ai/tools.mdx` and `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` go to #35041.
- Regenerated `packages/spec/api-surface/system.json` and `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json` (one added export each).
- One changeset (`@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/lint`, patch).

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts`: a skill bound to `read_file` and `create_upload_link` gets no finding. Control: a third name with the same shape that nobody registers (`upload_file`) is still reported at `skills[0].tools[2]`. **New control pin** `still reports the MCP file tools on a skill kept out of MCP (mcpPrompt: false) (#34948)`: `{ mcpPrompt: false, tools: ['read_file'] }` gives exactly one finding at `skills[0].tools[0]` naming `read_file`, and the same skill with `mcpPrompt` absent or `true` resolves cleanly. The `os explain` case requires the explanation to name `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES`, `only for a skill offered over MCP` and `` `mcpPrompt: false` ``.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-file-tools.test.ts` (new top-level `describe`, in the file tools' existing harness): `registerFileTools` on a full bridge returns exactly `MCP_FILE_TOOL_NAMES`, and `validateAiToolReferences` (aliased to lint source) resolves every name it registered. Control: a bridge with no file member registers nothing.
- `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.test.ts`: the new list is snake_case, sorted, duplicate-free, shares no name with the cloud registry and sits in no materialised family.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other MCP-door tools still warn (not changed here).** The door also registers `aggregate_records`, `delete_record`, `list_actions`, `run_action`, `resume_run`, `list_remote_tables` and `import_object`, none of which is in the cloud registry. Measured at head 2397798975 by calling `validateAiToolReferences` from the built `@objectstack/lint` with a skill binding all 16 door tools: those 7 names are still reported. This is the same family as this card. Whether a skill should bind each one is a separate decision (an action is reached as `action_NAME` through `run_action`, for example), so it is reported to the seat rather than widened here.
- **The published skill doc and the tools docs page are now incomplete.** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` ("Naming the tools: the resolution ladder") and `content/docs/ai/tools.mdx:193` list three sources. Filed as #35041 (blocked on this PR); the 7 other door tools are #35036.
- **The file surface grew** by claim amendments 6964425901 (`rule-explanations.ts`) and 6964615710 (the three S2 files).

## Verification

First round read against head `2397798975`; the fix round (S1, S2) against head `71597ee0a5`.
